meta.note: Light values are the Layers 3D scene workspace's own. Dark values are proposed for BetterCad; Layers has no dark theme. Holoroom is a third theme: the dark chrome with a black drawing surface and a yellow grid on floor, walls and ceiling.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: primary buttons (Done, Add a part), pressed tool buttons, focus rings, selected rows' text, drop zones. On `bar` and `rail` only; never as a large fill behind text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a selected part row, a pressed toolbar button, a chosen preset. Text on it is `accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (Done button, snap labels).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All UI text and icons on `bar`, `rail`, `stage` and `hover`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: notes, hints, field labels, units, status, rail labels, Cancel. 4.5:1 on `bar` and `rail` in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every 1px border and separator: bars, panels, inputs, popovers, dividers between sections.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Top bar, context bar, popovers, menus, dialogs, floating toolbars, inputs and the props panel background.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The side rails (parts tree, side panels), tiles' resting fill, wide secondary buttons.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The ground behind the viewport: the stage that frames the 3D view.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of buttons, rows and menu items; the fill of a joint's explode row.

tokens.name: viewport
tokens.usage: The 3D canvas itself, framed on `stage` with `shadow-frame`. Light keeps Layers' white sheet.

tokens.name: part-fill
tokens.usage: Flat fill of a solid in the viewport (Line art preset). Fold lines and the outline are `part-line`.

tokens.name: part-line
tokens.usage: Fold lines (1px) and the bold outline (3px) round each part, as on a flat-pack sheet.

tokens.name: part-line-dark
tokens.usage: Edge lines on a light-coloured part in every theme, so a pale part keeps dark outlines as in Light. Darker parts use `part-line`.

tokens.name: part-highlight
tokens.usage: Fill of a highlighted (selected, or this step's) part in the viewport. From Layers' HIGHLIGHT.

tokens.name: part-ghost
tokens.usage: Lines of a ghost part (fitted in an earlier step, or a reference body); its fill is a pale mix of `part-fill` and this. From Layers' GHOST.

tokens.name: snap
tokens.usage: Geometry feedback: snap points, joint rows and icons, the section arrow, the angle dial, face tints (at 32% alpha), the Section bar's title. Never for UI chrome, so blue always means geometry.

tokens.name: dimension
tokens.usage: Sketch dimensions: the extension lines, arrows and sizes drawn on a sketch, green as in Fusion. Holds 4.5:1 on `viewport`.

tokens.name: picked
tokens.usage: The snap or face already picked (the second face of a joint), with `picked-edge` as its ring.

tokens.name: picked-edge
tokens.usage: Ring round a `picked` snap marker.

tokens.name: snap-face
tokens.usage: The face under the pointer while you pick a joint snap: a very light grey in every theme, so its snap points stand out.

tokens.name: snap-point
tokens.usage: Joint snap points (small circles) and their ring's inside on `snap-face`. Holds 4.5:1 on `snap-face`.

tokens.name: snap-point-ring
tokens.usage: The ring round a joint snap point, so it reads on any part colour.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error status text, a part's missing-file mark, a context menu's Delete item. Pair with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Out-of-date and stale marks: the Update button, a stale hint, the amber frame.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a warning banner in a side panel; its text is `warn-ink`.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `warn-soft`.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: The X axis: view cube label, axis lines, the X handle. Red, as in Fusion and Snakie.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: The Y axis: view cube label, axis lines, the Y handle.

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: The Z axis: view cube label, axis lines, the Z handle.

tokens.name: cube-face
tokens.usage: View cube face, top of its vertical gradient to `cube-face-low`.

tokens.name: cube-face-low
tokens.usage: View cube face, bottom of the gradient.

tokens.name: cube-edge
tokens.usage: View cube edges (6px stroke on a 128px face texture).

tokens.name: cube-label
tokens.usage: FRONT / TOP / RIGHT lettering on the view cube.

tokens.name: tile-icon
tokens.usage: Icon colour on element tiles (shapes, primitives) at rest.

tokens.name: quiet-icon
tokens.usage: Row buttons that stay quiet until pointed at (eye, ghost, highlight in the parts tree) and drag grips. Decorative: not a text colour.

tokens.name: thumb-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a model thumbnail tile while it loads or has no picture.

tokens.name: thumb-ink
tokens.usage: The placeholder cube icon on `thumb-bg`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The overlay behind a full-screen workspace or dialog.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The drawing grid's minor lines on `viewport`, every 2 mm at the default zoom. In Holoroom it is the yellow grid on the floor, walls and ceiling.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: Every tenth grid line, and the two axis lines through the origin. In Holoroom, the bright yellow of the room's grid.

tokens.name: room
tokens.usage: The far walls and ceiling of the drawing room, drawn behind the grid when the camera looks up or out. Light and dark barely differ from `viewport`; Holoroom is true black.

tokens.name: icon-top
tokens.usage: Tool icons: the lit top face of an icon's muted solid. Icons are a soft blue-grey solid with one part in `icon-accent`.

tokens.name: icon-side
tokens.usage: Tool icons: the front-left face of an icon's solid, a step darker than `icon-top`.

tokens.name: icon-side-dark
tokens.usage: Tool icons: the front-right face, the darkest of the three, and the inside of holes and shells.

tokens.name: icon-edge
tokens.usage: Tool icons: outlines and drawn lines. Holds 3:1 on `bar` and `rail`, so icons read without their fills.

tokens.name: icon-hole
tokens.usage: Tool icons: openings cut right through, such as a gear's bore. The colour of `bar`.

tokens.name: icon-accent
tokens.usage: Tool icons: the one highlight on each icon, the part the tool makes or changes (the face that moves, the edge that rounds). Amber, so it never reads as selected, which is `accent`.

tokens.name: icon-accent-side
tokens.usage: Tool icons: a highlighted solid's front-left face.

tokens.name: icon-accent-dark
tokens.usage: Tool icons: a highlighted solid's front-right face.

families.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: ui
styles.sample: Drag to look around, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
styles.usage: The base: buttons, rows, menu items, inputs. Set on the app root.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Primary buttons, the editor title, a selected row's name, wide buttons.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Section headings inside a side panel or popover.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Add STL or STEP files, or drop them on the view.
styles.usage: Notes, hints, help under the viewport, field values, status text, template captions.

styles.name: small-strong
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside a panel section (`muted`), the Section bar's title, the explode count.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Units beside a number field, rail labels under their icon, a row's warning mark.

styles.name: micro-strong
styles.usage: Snap labels (on `accent`-free `snap` pills) and small badges.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Numbers in fields and read-outs, right-aligned with tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: dimension
styles.usage: Dimension labels drawn over a sketch; on a `bar` pill so they read over any part.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Headings outside the editor: the models list, account, sign-in. Intentional addition: Layers has no pages.

styles.name: page-body
styles.sample: Design in the browser, save to your account or to disk.
styles.usage: Running text outside the editor, at most 65 characters a line.

spacing.note: The scale Layers actually uses: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16. Control heights are 32px (26 and 28 inside rows), rails 72px, side panels 260 to 290px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a toolbar, between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a top bar's buttons; padding of a floating toolbar; separator margins.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a button between icon and label; grid gaps for tiles and fields; top bar vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons and bars; gap between a row's icon and name; small vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Popover padding; gap between the viewport and its toolbar; space between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Side panel padding; template and text-style tile padding; stage vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Panel body side padding; the Done button's side padding; a panel title's top margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Stage side padding; the page gutter outside the editor.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, selects and rows. Inside a dense row use 28px, inside a joint row 26px.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The icon rail (64px inline, 56px under 640px).

tokens.name: side-width
tokens.usage: The parts tree panel. The props panel is 280px, a layers panel 290px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, rows, menu items, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles, wide buttons, rail buttons, part rows, templates, popover menus (the `--lyr-radius`).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating toolbars over the stage, popovers, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The editor frame and the drop zone.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Snap labels and dimension pills.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: A floating toolbar over the stage; a pressed rail button (0 1px 3px at 8%).

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: The viewport frame on the stage; the selection toolbar (0 2px 10px at 16%).

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and context menus.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: A floating dialog over the viewport (the joint dialog).

tokens.name: shadow-editor
tokens.usage: The inline editor frame on a page.
